decision_conditions: The trees are located to the rear of 50 Broadwood Avenue. The mature oak appears to be in good condition and positively contributes to the arboreal nature of the area. The tree can be viewed from neighboring properties and are partially visible from Broadwood Avenue. The condition and stature of the trees give them a high amenity value.

This application has been refused as there is a lack of evidence to implicate the tree. Within the application we would expect to see seasonal ground movement data that would indicate seasonal clay shrinkage and show the the levels of damage.
Without this evidence we cannot conclusively prove that the tree is the primary cause of any subsidence.
Having regard to the reasons given for the proposed work, the work is unjustified and will have a detrimental impact on the visual amenity and arboreal character of the area.
The removal of deadwood, dangerous / hanging branches and ivy:  This does not require the formal consent of the Council.
